title: Information Authority: Unity-free reproduction artifact for a knowledge-provenance non-cheating tactical-AI paper
description: Unity-free, deterministic reproduction bundle (code subset, tracked scenario manifests, Dockerfile, GitHub Actions workflow, and reference result tables) for the paper "Information Authority: A Knowledge-Provenance Architecture for Non-Cheating Tactical AI, with Unity-Free Reproducible Verification." It verifies that a central output validator rejects any decision derived from privileged ("god-view") simulation truth, that an auditable bait scenario presents privileged enemy data the honest path refuses, and that a fail-closed negative control is caught and classified -- reproduced bit-for-bit in a clean containerized CI environment. This is a software-architecture, verification, and reproducibility artifact only; it makes no human-realistic-behavior, tactical-superiority, operational, medical, targeting, surveillance, or weapon-control claim.
